bible_verses.english: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”
He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up and rebuked the winds and the sea, and there was a great calm.
In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for being near to me even when the winds blow and the night feels dark. When fear tries to take root, help me to speak faith over my doubts and turn to You in prayer. Strengthen my heart to trust that You are in control of every storm I face. May Your abiding presence fill me with quiet peace and unwavering hope today. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When the storms of life gather and doubt creeps into our hearts, this hymn reminds us that Jesus is right here in the boat with us. We do not have to fight anxiety alone; instead, we are invited to bring every fear to Him in honest, persistent prayer. Because Christ is present and faithful, we can face uncertain roads with a peaceful smile. Let us lay down our unbelief today and rest securely in the Savior who never leaves our side.
